open_points.subject: discard_new_store
open_points.text: discard_new_store: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST act only on a store open_store made new in this process, answering removed false and touching nothing otherwise; it MUST close the store's connection, then remove each companion file whose path is the store's path followed by a suffix of the imported STORE_COMPANION_SUFFIXES constant, in the order of that constant, and last the store's file, reading each path's type without following a link, removing only a regular file, passing over a path that does not exist, and stopping at the first step that fails.
open_points.other_text: DiscardStep enum members: CLOSE_CONNECTION='close_connection', COMPANION_JOURNAL='companion_journal', COMPANION_SHM='companion_shm', COMPANION_WAL='companion_wal', STORE_FILE='store_file'
open_points.question: STORE_COMPANION_SUFFIXES has the declared type tuple[str, ...], so it may contain any number of suffixes and carries no DiscardStep for each suffix, while every failed companion removal must be represented by one of exactly three companion steps. Which passage must change: must the imported policy carry suffix-to-DiscardStep pairs, or must the requirement constrain and map the suffix tuple to those three enum members?
